name: VB1-I
summary:
VB1-I is a VMR/VersaBot wheeled humanoid platform within Lanxin Robotics’ product portfolio. The official catalog describes industrial and office applications that combine mobile navigation, object handling and human interaction.

The platform uses articulated arms with electric grippers and depth sensing. The manufacturer describes SLAM navigation, camera-assisted alignment, obstacle detection and charging support. VB1 and VB1-I have separate chassis, working-height and runtime configurations; their specifications should be compared by exact model.
